appended_landmarks.meaning: Terminal RH E7 arrival completing the final long ascent; visual clearing begins after the attack while the held note may ring; not an acoustic release or settling chord

limits: arrival is score-defined intent; acoustic detector returns sole local tuned E7 growth consistent with context, not certified written identity, physical keystrike or hand provenance
later left-hand/broken figuration continues; m633/634 and m644 are distinct events
independent music review is required; unavailable listening must be disclosed and is not a demonstrated musical-quality pass; diagnostics are not calibrated confidence probabilities
held-out prefix registration requires18 coherent frequency observations; ordered trajectory is diagnostic only and does not certify performed strikes
prefix registration is bounded to40cents and1cent per semitone; terminal-only retuning is forbidden
original terminal DTW interval plus350ms and original global context limits remain; no existing timing or QA threshold is widened
a different sole E7 inside the search window and smoothly modulated already-ringing E7 can qualify; explicit identity limitations are calibrated and documented
new terminal uses declared fundamental support, tonality and unique new-growth gates; old3cue bass refinement and chroma gates remain unchanged
